description: This file contains classes and methods for transforming and adapting Google GenAI generate_content requests and responses to and from the litellm framework, including streaming support and handling of tool calls and message formats.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIStreamWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for streaming Google GenAI generate_content responses, transforming OpenAI streaming chunks to Google GenAI format.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for transforming Google GenAI generate_content requests to/from litellm.completion format, including message and tool call transformations.

methods.name: translate_generate_content_to_completion
methods.description: Transforms Google GenAI generate_content request into litellm completion format.

methods.name: _add_generic_litellm_params_to_request
methods.description: Adds generic litellm parameters (like API base, key, version) to the request dict.

methods.name: translate_completion_output_params_streaming
methods.description: Transforms streaming completion output to Google GenAI format, returning an async iterator of bytes.

methods.name: _transform_google_genai_tools_to_openai
methods.description: Converts Google GenAI tools schema to OpenAI tools format.

methods.name: _transform_google_genai_tool_config_to_openai
methods.description: Converts Google GenAI tool configuration to OpenAI tool choice format.

methods.name: _transform_contents_to_messages
methods.description: Transforms Google GenAI message contents into OpenAI message format.

methods.name: translate_completion_to_generate_content
methods.description: Transforms litellm completion response into Google GenAI generate_content format.

methods.name: translate_streaming_completion_to_generate_content
methods.description: Transforms streaming litellm completion chunk into Google GenAI generate_content format.

methods.name: _transform_openai_message_to_google_genai_parts
methods.description: Converts OpenAI message object to Google GenAI parts format.

methods.name: _transform_openai_delta_to_google_genai_parts_with_accumulation
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI delta to Google GenAI parts, accumulating streaming tool calls.

methods.name: _map_finish_reason
methods.description: Maps OpenAI finish reasons to Google GenAI finish reasons.

methods.name: _map_usage
methods.description: Maps OpenAI usage metrics to Google GenAI usage format.
